mapper.update: UPDATE account_dummy_tbl ad INNER JOIN linked_account_tbl la ON (la.account_number = ad.account_number AND la.primary_yn = 'Y' AND la.user_id = #{userId}) SET ad.balance = CASE WHEN ad.balance >= #{amount} THEN ad.balance - #{amount} ELSE 0 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_transaction_tbl (user_id, spending_category_id, transaction_type, source_type, target_type, transaction_status, amount, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 1, 'CHARGE', 'ACCOUNT', 'WALLET', 'SUCCESS', #{amount}, NOW())

INSERT INTO financial_transaction_tbl (user_id, receive_id, settlement_id, spending_category_id, transaction_type, source_type, target_type, transaction_status, amount, merchant_name, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverId}, #{settlementId}, COALESCE(#{spendingCategoryId}, 1), 'TRANSFER', 'WALLET', #{receiverType}, 'SUCCESS', #{amount}, #{merchantName}, NOW())

INSERT INTO feed_tbl (user_id, target_id, feed_type, content, visibility, feed_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{transactionId}, #{feedType}, #{content}, #{visibility}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT bank_code AS bankCode, bank_name AS bankName FROM bank_tbl ORDER BY bank_code ASC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rm.memo_content, ':', 2), ':', -1) AS accountNumber, SUBSTRING_INDEX(rm.memo_content, ':', 1) AS bankCode, COALESCE(b.bank_name, 'KB국민') AS bankName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rm.memo_content, ':', 3), ':', -1) AS ownerName, MAX(t.created_at) AS lastTransferAt FROM financial_transaction_tbl t INNER JOIN receipt_memo_tbl rm ON t.transaction_id = rm.transaction_id LEFT JOIN bank_tbl b ON SUBSTRING_INDEX(rm.memo_content, ':', 1) = b.bank_code WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_type = 'TRANSFER' AND t.target_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND rm.memo_content LIKE '%:%:%' GROUP BY accountNumber, bankCode, bankName, ownerName ORDER BY lastTransferAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT owner_name FROM account_dummy_tbl WHERE (bank_code = #{bankCode} OR #{bankCode} IS NULL OR #{bankCode} = '') AND REPLACE(account_number, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{accountNumber}, '-', '') LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(ad.user_id, la.user_id) FROM account_dummy_tbl ad LEFT JOIN linked_account_tbl la ON REPLACE(ad.account_number, '-', '') = REPLACE(la.account_number, '-', '') WHERE (ad.bank_code = #{bankCode} OR #{bankCode} IS NULL OR #{bankCode} = '') AND REPLACE(ad.account_number, '-', '') = REPLACE(#{accountNumber}, '-', '') LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(p.nickname, u.user_name, '친구') FROM user_tbl u LEFT JOIN profile_tbl p ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt_memo_tbl (transaction_id, memo_content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE memo_content = #{memo}, updated_at = NOW()
